description: A black steam locomotive pulling dark blue passenger carriages through deep snow at night in a mountain valley, smoke rising, one carriage window lit gold. Snowy pines, peaks and a starry cloudy sky; oil-paint style, edge to edge, no figures. Painted lettering in a band on the carriage side reads roughly like a railway company name, plus smaller marks below it.
reason: Painted lettering runs along the blue carriage side, looking like a company name with smaller marks beneath. Repaint the carriage with plain panels and no lettering or plaques.
